input.command:
python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0036.png").convert("RGB"))
# Look at the blue bottle on the right: u > 400
blue_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 150) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50)
pts = np.argwhere(blue_mask)
print(f"Blue pixels: {len(pts)}")
print(f"Min u: {pts[:,1].min()}, max u: {pts[:,1].max()}")
print(f"Min v: {pts[:,0].min()}, max v: {pts[:,0].max()}")
# Find contact with floor (highest v)
contact_v = pts[:, 0].max()
contact_u = pts[pts[:, 0] == contact_v, 1].mean()
print(f"Bottom contact: u={contact_u}, v={contact_v}")

f = 256.0
H = 1.55
th = np.radians(45.0)
xc, yc = 0.067, 3.982
Zc = f * H / (contact_v - 256.0)
Xc = (contact_u - 256.0) * H / (contact_v - 256.0)
Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
print(f"Blue cylinder contact: Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f} -> World: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f})")
'
